heading: Explore our game development expertise across every platform

items.heading: iOS game development
items.bodyHtml:
Delight iPhone and iPad players with smooth, beautiful games built for Apple hardware.

Our iOS game developers use Unity and native tools to build games that take full advantage of Apple devices, from touch controls and haptics to Game Center integration and App Store launch.

bullets.html: Optimized for iPhone and iPad hardware
Game Center, in-app purchases and ads
App Store submission and launch support

image.alt: iOS game development by KeyDevs Technologies

items.heading: Android game development
items.bodyHtml:
Reach the largest mobile gaming audience with games that run well on every device.

We build Android games tuned for the huge variety of screens, chipsets and OS versions in the market, with careful testing so players get smooth frame rates everywhere.

image.alt: Android game development by KeyDevs Technologies

items.heading: 2D and 3D game development
items.bodyHtml:
From charming pixel art to rich 3D worlds, we build the style your game needs.

Our artists and Unity developers create characters, environments, animations and gameplay systems for 2D and 3D games in every genre, from puzzle and arcade to racing and action.

image.alt: 2D and 3D game development by KeyDevs Technologies

items.heading: Augmented reality game development
items.bodyHtml:
Blend the real world with play for experiences that feel like magic.

We build AR games for phones and tablets using ARKit, ARCore and Unity, with location-based play, image tracking and interactive 3D characters placed in the player’s surroundings.

image.alt: Augmented reality game development by KeyDevs Technologies

items.heading: Virtual reality game development
items.bodyHtml:
Put players inside the game with fully immersive virtual reality.

From Oculus and Google VR to mixed reality headsets, we build VR games with comfortable controls, believable worlds and the performance headsets demand.

bullets.html: Oculus, Google VR and mixed reality

image.alt: Virtual reality game development by KeyDevs Technologies

items.heading: Windows and Mac game development
items.bodyHtml:
Bring your game to the desktop with full-featured PC and Mac builds.

We develop and port games for Windows and macOS with keyboard, mouse and controller support, higher fidelity graphics and distribution through the popular PC game stores.

bullets.html: Windows and macOS builds from one project
